reviewDescription: I’m a plus size woman who typically wears a size US14-16, and while this fit my body without feeling too tight or constricting, I felt like it ended up looking very shapeless. The material is on the heavier side so it was kind of falling down and sagging and it didn’t cling to my curves at all so I looked like a big pink rectangle. I tried wearing some shape wear underneath as well, but that just made me look a bit smoother, not any curvier. I also overheat a lot due to a medical condition and I don’t see myself ever being able to actually wear this due to how warm it is. The quality of the dress itself is fine, it has a lot of stretch which is nice, and the color and the ribbed texture are pretty. I just think this is one of those dresses that is just made to look good on very small people.
